integrity: Proved asymptotic consequences of cited frame-bound identities, with finite independent numerical corroboration; not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Integer redundancy, rectangular Gabor lattices, one-sided exponential windows. Asymptotic results only; known exact frame-bound functions and optimizer uniqueness are cited rather than newly proved. Possible earlier asymptotic analysis of the same functions remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp coalescence and cubic regret for one-sided exponential Gabor lattices
